name: tripwire-monorepo
description: Mutation testing for Kane CLI browser suites: break the app on purpose, see whether the tests notice.

scripts.report:publish: node packages/cli/bin/tripwire.js report --dir demo/shop/.tripwire && node packages/cli/bin/tripwire.js report --dir demo/third-party/.tripwire && node -e "const fs=require('fs');fs.rmSync('docs',{recursive:true,force:true});fs.cpSync('demo/shop/.tripwire/report','docs',{recursive:true});fs.cpSync('demo/third-party/.tripwire/report','docs/todomvc',{recursive:true});fs.writeFileSync('docs/.nojekyll','')"
